Subject: Vendor onboarding: remit & tax info needed to create vendor record / PO

Hi Samir —

Welcome and thanks for partnering with Redwood. To get Novaforge set up in our AP system and to issue the first PO, we need a quick vendor intake packet from you. Can you provide the items below? We prefer to receive bank routing/account info via the secure upload link (see below) or via DocuSign — do not send bank details in plain email.

Required items:
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices
- Remit-to address (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Tax ID / EIN and a completed W-9 (for US entities)
- Preferred payment method (ACH or wire) and ACH remittance form if ACH
- Remit-to email for PO/invoice receipt and AP contact name/phone
- Point of contact for contract counter-signature (if applicable)

I attached our Vendor_Buyer_Intake_Form.xlsx and a W-9 template to this message for convenience. Once we have these items we can create a vendor code and raise the PO (standard Net30 unless you requested otherwise).

Secure upload for bank details / sensitive docs: https://redwood.app/secure-upload/novaforge-20250902
HubSpot deal (for reference): https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-7882

Thanks — appreciate a reply by end of week if possible.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Confirming: payment terms will be Net30 from date of invoice, standard PO-driven process. We typically issue a PO once the vendor record is created and legal has confirmed the counterparty details.

Next steps from our side:
- I will open a vendor creation request with AP and attach the W-9 and intake form (ETA 1–2 business days).
- Marissa (cc'd) will run the vendor terms through Legal if any special clauses are present; otherwise we'll proceed to create vendor without changes.
- Once vendor ID is assigned I will update HubSpot and send over the PO number to Olivia/your AP.

If you want expedited payment (e.g., earlier than Net30) let me know and we can discuss but that will require approvals.
